overview: Kicks The Complete Sneakers Store is a luxury, cinematic sneaker ecommerce website with a deep red premium aesthetic, real-time order notifications via WhatsApp and email, UPI QR code payments, and a fully animated shopping experience.
features: Luxury red cinematic UI with glassmorphism and 60fps animations
Slide-in cart drawer with persistence and live totals
Premium checkout with COD and UPI QR code payment
Real email notifications to store owner and customer via Resend API
Instant WhatsApp order alerts via CallMeBot
Flagship mobile experience with sticky navigation
Full product catalog with animated cards and hover effects
